The lifted universal cover is complete and has the same Ricci bound, hence compact by Bonnet-Myers. A covering fibre is a closed discrete subspace of a compact Hausdorff space; its open singleton cover has a finite subcover. The deck group is identified with pi_1 and acts freely on the finite fibre. This proof does not assume finite sheetedness before deriving it.
